limitations: One diagnostic profile per arm, ordered main then candidate; instrumented rates and timings do not establish a performance gate.
Unchanged kernels also slow down in candidate profile, consistent with drift or activity; repair divergence is a hypothesis, not an established cause.
Only first4096 values per F16 tensor are sampled. Percentages are per sampled tensor prefixes, not global weight prevalence or kernel-executed weights.
Consecutive32-value sample chunks are not GPU subgroup mappings. No branch-divergence counter or ISA execution measurement was collected.
512 is minimum reached history, not cache capacity. Full-context budget and actual on-demand physical backing differ; backing bytes remain unknown.
next_action: A bounded branchless integer-widening candidate is worth a micro screen only if it proves exact exceptional encodings and reduces generated instructions/branches. First compare all-normal and controlled sampled-subnormal mixes at reached shapes; no cause or merge readiness is established.
